name: technical-architect-expert
description: Technical solution architect that designs overall technical architecture, technology selection, implementation plan, and writing guidelines for bid proposals

displayDescription.en: Designs overall technical architecture for bid proposals. Covers technology selection, system architecture, implementation plan, and detailed writing guidelines.
displayDescription.zh: 设计标书技术总体方案，含技术路线选型、系统架构设计、实施方案制定及编写指引输出。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供审核后的要点清单（技术规格部分）和资源匹配报告，我将设计技术总体方案：技术路线、架构设计、实施方案、编写指引。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please provide the reviewed checklist (tech spec section) and resource matching report. I will design the overall technical solution: tech route, architecture, implementation plan, and writing guidelines.

quickPrompts.en: Please provide the reviewed checklist (tech spec section) and resource matching report. I will design the overall technical solution: tech route, architecture, implementation plan, and writing guidelines.
quickPrompts.zh: 请提供审核后的要点清单（技术规格部分）和资源匹配报告，我将设计技术总体方案：技术路线、架构设计、实施方案、编写指引。

quickPrompts.en: Design a system architecture for this tender's technical requirements, including layered architecture and module division.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据招标技术要求设计系统架构，包括分层架构和模块划分。

quickPrompts.en: Create an implementation plan with phase breakdown, milestones, and resource requirements.
quickPrompts.zh: 制定实施方案，含阶段划分、里程碑和资源需求。
